views.markdown: Real-time synced lyrics & album-art Metal mesh dynamic wallpaper on your iOS Lock Screen & Home Screen!

#### Version 1.0.0

Initial release: Real-time synced lock screen lyrics with LRCLIB, lrc.red, and Musixmatch support, MediaRemote true elapsed-time synchronization, customizable positioning, and live draggable interface.

#### Version 1.1.0

Added SpicyLyrics provider support (developers.spicylyrics.org API key) with syllable and line level sync.

#### Version 1.1.1

Fix stuck/joined words on SpicyLyrics syllable-level sync by honoring the IsPartOfWord flag and word spacing boundaries.

#### Version 1.2.0

Added a Y Position slider with a live interactive Lock Screen preview in Settings (supports tapping the preview, center-snap haptic guide, and live syncing with presets, line count, and font size).

#### Version 1.2.1

Fixed Settings crash on iOS 18 arm64e caused by NSNotificationCenter/Swift Foundation bridging in the Lock Screen preview.

#### Version 1.2.2

Lock Screen preview in Settings now displays real lyrics, song title, artist, and playback progress from a random previously played song at a random timestamp (with a shuffle button and SpicyLyrics offline cache format fix).

#### Version 1.3.0

Added Album-Art Dynamic Metal Mesh Gradient Wallpaper (CIE LAB compute shader), true Lock Screen Wallpaper Layer mode (renders behind notifications, clock & glass blur cards), smart GPU/timer power-saver hooks (backlight, Low Power Mode, pause/unlock auto-freeze), and Settings controls with live gradient preview.

#### Version 1.3.1

Added Home Screen support for the Dynamic Album-Art Metal Mesh Gradient Wallpaper (without lyrics), supporting both separate and paired iOS 16–18 wallpapers with automatic GPU pause when inside apps, plus a new 'Show on Home Screen' toggle in Settings.

#### Version 1.3.2

Added random previously played song album-art dynamic wallpaper on both Lock Screen and Home Screen (without lyrics) when nothing is playing, with persistent offline palette caching, automatic refresh on screen wake, and a 'Random Song Art When Idle' toggle in Settings.
